_comment: DESK-0-SCHEMA + DESK-0B-SCHEMA-V2: desk decision records (docs/plans/claude-trading-desk-DESIGN.md sections 2.1, 2.4, 3.7, 3.8, 4A). v2 (schema_version 2): the desk is a TRADER, not a reviewer -- role entry_generation (no_trade / propose_entry / watch_note) judges a SCAN packet and proposes the desk's own trades; market_watch and its veto-shaped enum are deleted. Every row carries priced alternatives[] and a training marker; the stable-id chain is packet_id <- decision_id -> intent_id -> order_package_id -> trade_id (per account) -> outcome_id, with outcomes.jsonl (DESK-20 writes it) and consumed.jsonl (dataset builds record what they trained on; a decision in no build is never-trained-on). schema_version 1 rows were never written (0 rows when v2 landed) and are not accepted. comms/desk/{decisions,touches,outcomes,consumed}.jsonl are APPEND-ONLY JSONL, one object per line, both start EMPTY; a leading {"_meta": ...} line is skipped. The envelope extends comms/schema/live_review.schema.json; live_review rows are NOT desk rows and are NOT re-validated here. CLOSED ENUMS: prose is bookkeeping, never a label. `action` is closed PER ROLE (role_actions); no enum contains a size change, a widened stop, a mode/execution change or a halt (Prime Directive rules 2 and 7) -- the closed enum IS that rule. A desk ENTRY is propose_entry with a full `proposal` (no size field: each account's RiskManager sizes it; a real predictive TP: the TP doctrine binds at proposal time). `model` is a TIER, never a model identifier (public repo). COLLAPSED-STATE RULE: unmeasured is null, never 0. EXTERNAL CONTEXT (DECIDED 2026-10-25, 'Repo feeds + logged exception'): the packet is the default and only feed; a pull is allowed only on a calendar / swing due event or an escalation, is logged with sources and fetch time, never folds into the packet, and marks the row reproducible=false so replays and training sets can exclude it. SANDBOX TOUCH (DESIGN 3.6, DESK-12): every applied desk effect on an account writes a touch row; a package-account pair is desk-touched from its first applied intent, and graders split touched from untouched. Cross-file and conditional rules live in scripts/ci/check_desk_records.py (guard `desk-records-guard`).

order_package_id._comment: null on entry_generation rows: the claude_desk leg creates the package later and carries decision_id; outcomes.jsonl closes the join

label_source._comment: live = decided on a live packet and eligible to apply; shadow = live packet, recorded only; historical_masked / synthetic = offline sessions (design 4C), never applied

pre_cutoff._comment: true when the packet's info_cutoff_at predates the judge model's knowledge cutoff (the memory trap, design 4C.2): may train a student, never gates one

proposal._comment: propose_entry only (null otherwise). Design 2.4: every field required, none defaulted. NO SIZE FIELD -- each account's RiskManager sizes a claude_desk package. tp is a REAL predictive target (TP doctrine): a level with a basis and p_hit, never a sentinel distance, a venue-cap level or 'trail decides'.

expected_r_net._comment: null ONLY on a mechanics-probe row (basis mechanics, no EV claim); the guard enforces both directions

max_hold_min._comment: OPTIONAL (absent on rows before 2026-10-27). Minutes after the fill at which the claude_desk leg closes the trade at market (src/units/strategies/claude_desk.py monitor). REQUIRED and <= 60 on a label_source live row: a live desk trade is the short-hold kind (operator 2026-10-27: get in and get out quickly), managed by its per-trade session (SHORT-HOLD-BRIEF.md).

alternatives._comment: design 4A: the actions the role could have taken, each with its counterfactual from the packet (entry: forward-R base rate; in_trade: the LTR-0 table) or a later replay. Exactly one is `chosen` and it is the row's action; the role default is always listed. not_priced => every number null (DESK-7 prices them).

rationale._comment: prose is bookkeeping, never a label or a feature

trade_id._comment: the per-account trade the action landed on (stable-id chain); null when not applied or not yet known

items._comment: DESK-14 (operator 2026-10-27): one entry per outside source the wake used, logged POINT-IN-TIME-AT-DECISION. DECIDED by popup 2026-10-27 ('Use judged_at'): retrieved_at <= judged_at (NOT <= info_cutoff_at: a live wake searches after its packet's cutoff). The row's effective information time for replay/training is max(info_cutoff_at, max retrieved_at). content_sha256 is the sha256 of the text read (the text itself is not stored); values holds the field/value pairs actually used. feed_gap names the data feed the packet lacks (a recurring decisive gap is how a feed gets wired). Optional so rows written before DESK-14 (object-only, trigger calendar|swing|escalation) still validate; a non-empty items[] needs trigger 'judgement' and is train-eligible, gate-INeligible, training.source 'external'.

training._comment: the training marker, written once, derived (the guard recomputes it): synthetic, or legacy object-only external_context (no items[]), => not train-eligible; items-based external_context => train-eligible, gate-ineligible, training.source 'external'; historical_masked or pre_cutoff => trains, never gates. Whether the row WAS trained on is never mutated here: it is the row's presence in consumed.jsonl, and a train-eligible row in no build is never-trained-on (DESK-21's detector reads never_trained_on()).

source._comment: DESK-14: 'external' flags a row whose decision used outside sources (external_context.items[]); absent otherwise

outcomes._comment: comms/desk/outcomes.jsonl (DESK-20 writes it; empty until then). One row per decision x account x outcome kind, T1 only: computed_at is after the decision's info_cutoff_at. replayed = the decision's bracket (or chosen action) on the real path, computed; realised = an account's fill and close, measured, keyed by trade_id. Any net_r is net of the full cost stack and names its cost policy. not_computable carries a reason and null numbers (could-not-look is never zero).

consumed._comment: comms/desk/consumed.jsonl: a dataset build records each decision_id it trained on. Only a train-eligible decision may appear (a consumed external_context or synthetic row is a leak).

touches._comment: DESIGN 3.6 point 2: {order_package_id, account, intent_id, decision_id, applied_at, level_before, level_after, verdict}. A touch row exists only for an APPLIED desk effect, so verdict is approve or clip. `sandbox` is true exactly when account == sandbox_account (bybit_1) -- the DECIDED 'shadow the bybit_1 soak book'; soak_report.py / live-vs-backtest / cost-fidelity graders split touched from untouched on it.
